summary:
- Reload restored pages after app updates and recover failed tabs when selected.
- Simplify the sidebar and remove the site title from the top bar.
- Create named browser profiles; tabs from older workspaces stay in General.
- Move completed sign-ins from a popup into the main window.
- Add bookmarks and private tabs.
- Keep keyboard shortcuts working when a webpage captures the key.
- Save browsing history in batches instead of writing on every update.
